# FFmpeg 9.1 (LGPL, shared libraries for Windows x86-64)
#
# English | 简体中文: see BUILD-INFO.zh-CN.txt
#
# Built from the official FFmpeg source (n9.1), using mingw-w64 GCC and
# scripts/build_ffmpeg_mingw.sh. Only LGPL-compatible components are enabled:
# H.264/HEVC decoders, MP4/Matroska/MPEG-TS/raw demuxers, the
# h264_mp4toannexb / hevc_mp4toannexb bitstream filters and swscale.
#
#   --enable-shared --disable-static
#   --disable-everything
#   --enable-avformat --enable-avcodec --enable-avutil --enable-swscale
#   --enable-demuxer=mov,matroska,mpegts,h264,hevc
#   --enable-decoder=h264,hevc --enable-parser=h264,hevc
#   --enable-bsf=h264_mp4toannexb,hevc_mp4toannexb
#   --disable-network --disable-autodetect --disable-zlib --disable-bzlib
#   --disable-lzma --disable-iconv --disable-sdl2 --disable-xlib
#
# Rebuild it with scripts/build_ffmpeg_mingw.sh rather than checking binaries
# into git. The FFmpeg DLLs are linked dynamically and may be replaced with
# compatible FFmpeg 9.1 builds. See COPYING.LGPLv2.1 for the license terms.
#
# Source code: FFmpeg n9.1 (https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz,
# tag n9.1 of the FFmpeg repository).
